<thought>We need a valid CO₂ CIF that the tool can parse. I will provide a minimal CIF containing the cell parameters and an atom site loop. Then use add_adsorbate_to_slab_text to place the molecule 2 Å above the TiO₂ slab (no specific site). Finally, write the combined structure to a CIF file and return its path.</thought>
<action>add_adsorbate_to_slab_text</action>
